notes: Flagged large unit reviewed and retained: לְ + מַעַל + directive he + מִן is rendered by the single fixed English expression over and above, and neither splitting (over and / above) leaves a defensible rendering for either preposition (rules 30, 32); headed on מַעַל under rule 23.

Moreover is given to the waw and also to עוֹד under rule 14's two-morpheme count; the competing reading gives Moreover to עוֹד as the word writing its own lexeme and also to the waw, and both English words are attested waw renderings, so this remains a genuine tie named here rather than settled.
seeing that is one added unit under rules 55 and 2, the possessive clause having no conjunction morpheme in it.
of mine own is kept inside the סְגֻלָּה unit as the ASV's rendering of a peculiar treasure; the competing reading marks it added, since the לִי has already been spent on I have under rule 43.
